Zymera · Overnight result

Does the planner earn its keep on walled maps? Yes — decisively on random obstacles.

Trained-from-scratch MAPPO-CTDE, one-variable swap (greedy → MVProp planner), identical connectivity stack. Coverage + connectivity, per terrain, seed-aggregated.

Headline. On clutter (scattered obstacles that trap a reactive controller) MVProp more than doubles greedy's coverage at 32² (58.8% vs 25.7%). On rooms/mixed (large open areas + doorways) the edge is real but modest (+2–7 pts). The cost is a small connectivity dip — MVProp covers more by spreading to reach farther goals (conn ~0.87–0.97 vs greedy ~0.92–0.99); both stay mission-valid.
